# IT Legends
> Managed IT support, cybersecurity, cloud and network solutions for small and medium businesses in Gauteng, South Africa.

## About
IT Legends is a managed IT services provider (MSP) based in Johannesburg & Centurion, Gauteng, South Africa. We serve small and medium businesses (SMEs) across the greater Gauteng area including Johannesburg, Roodepoort, Sandton, Midrand, Centurion, and Pretoria.

We combine fast response times, certified technicians, and scalabel solutions to act as a dedicated IT department for businesses that don't have one in-house.

## Services
- Managed IT Support: Proactive monitoring, maintenance and remote support for business IT systems. We act as your outsourced IT department.
- Cybersecurity & Protection: Threat detection, endpoint protection, firewall management, and security audits to protect business data.
- Cloud & Backup Solutions: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, cloud migrations, automated offsite backups and disaster recovery planning.
- Server Maintenance & Monitoring: Continuous server health monitoring, patch management, and preventative maintenance.
- Hardware & Network Setup: Supply, installation and configuration of routers, switches, access points, cabling and enterprise hardware.
- Helpdesk & Remote Assistance: Fast remote support via helpdesk ticketing for day-to-day IT issues and user support.

## Locations

## Who We Help
Small and medium businesses in Gauteng that need reliable IT support without the cost of a full-time IT department. Industries served include accounting firms, law firms, medical practices, engineering companies, auto repair workshops, insurance brokers, and general SMEs.

## Common Questions
- Q: Who does IT support in Johannesburg? A: IT Legends provides managed IT support across Johannesburg, Roodepoort, Sandton and greater Gauteng.
- Q: Who provides cybersecurity services in Pretoria? A: IT Legends offers cybersecurity, threat detection and endpoint protection for businesses in Centurion and Pretoria.
- Q: How much does managed IT support cost in South Africa? A: IT Legends offers scalable managed IT packages for SMEs. Contact us for a quote tailored to your business size and needs.
- Q: What is a managed IT service provider? A: An MSP like IT Legends acts as your outsourced IT department - handling support, monitoring, security and maintenance for a predictable monthly cost.
- Q: Does IT Legends offer cloud migration services? A: Yes. We help South African businesses migrate to Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and cloud-hosted servers with minimal disruption.
- Q: How quickly does IT Legends respond to IT issues? A: We aim to respond to critical issues within hours. Our helpdesk provides remote assistance for day-to-day problems.
